_doc: Word limits of the demo packs' labelled questions (T-221 C1). Copied from the pack-source tables (demo-data/pack-sources/), not invented; a test checks each against the table text. Rule (same as the held-out keys, eval/keys/README.md rules 5, 7, 9): a limit printed with the question is its word_limit; a limit shared across several questions (S04 4.1-4.3) is null on each member; a combined limit inside one item (S08 Q5 parts a and b) is that item's word_limit; a page limit or no limit is null (the draft task takes words only). Not a frozen file.
